players.name: Cal Raleigh
players.summary: Cal Raleigh placed on 10-day IL for first time in career with right oblique strain. Mariners will shut him down one week then reassess; earliest return May 24.

sources.title: Cal Raleigh on his oblique injury and rehab timeline

players.name: Bryce Harper
players.summary: Harper laced a 2-run double in the 9th inning at PNC Park Saturday, healthy after his May 9 migraine scare. He is batting .283 with 11 HR and 29 RBI on the season.

sources.title: Bryce Harper and Phillies face Pirates on May 16

players.name: Luis Arraez
players.summary: Arraez went 4-for-5 with his first HR of the season in a 5-2 loss to the Athletics. His thumb has cleared up and he's on a hot streak.

sources.title: Giants observations: Loss to Athletics — NBC Sports Bay Area

players.name: Bo Bichette
players.summary: Bichette went 0-for-2 with a walk and scored a run in the Mets' 6-3 win. Scout concerns persist about a lingering PCL knee issue from 2025 affecting his sprint speed (25.4 ft/sec, down from last year).

sources.title: MLB Scouts Give Mets Concerning Injury Update on Bo Bichette

players.name: Lindor/McGonigle
players.summary: Kevin McGonigle singled in 4 AB as the Tigers fell 2-1 in 10 innings to the Blue Jays. The rookie recently signed an 8-year, $150M extension and is a leading AL ROY candidate.

sources.title: MLB Rookie Rankings: Kevin McGonigle better than expected for Tigers

players.name: Pete Crow-Armstrong
players.summary: PCA belted a 2-run homer in the 9th to make the Cubs' 8-3 loss to the White Sox more respectable. He's on a six-game hitting streak and finding his swing after a slow start.

sources.title: Cubs' Pete Crow-Armstrong: Smacks late homer in blowout loss

players.name: Jackson Merrill
players.summary: Merrill drove in the game's first run with an RBI single in the 1st inning as the Padres beat Seattle 7-4. He is hitting .471 over his last four contests after a 0-for-16 cold stretch.

sources.title: Jackson Merrill hits walk-off double vs. Mariners

players.name: Teoscar Hernandez
players.summary: Teoscar Hernandez returned from the IL Saturday and posted 2 RBI in the Dodgers' 15-2 blowout win over the Angels. Since being dropped in the lineup he has been the Dodgers' hottest hitter.

sources.title: Teoscar Hernandez Responded Really Well To Dodgers Lineup Change

players.name: Stanton/Rice
players.summary: Ben Rice went 0-for-3 in the Yankees' 6-3 loss at Citi Field in his first game back from a left hand contusion. He leads all of baseball with a 1.214 OPS on the season.

sources.title: New York Yankees Announce Ben Rice Decision For Mets Game

players.name: Devin Williams
players.summary: Williams nailed down save #7 in the Mets' 6-3 win over the Yankees, extending his scoreless streak to 7 outings. His resurgence is tied to adjustments in pitch mix with the Mets' coaching staff.

sources.title: Devin Williams secures save for Mets | 05/16/2026

players.name: Zack Wheeler
players.summary: Wheeler earned a win Friday vs. Miami (6 IP, 1 ER, 8 K) and is between starts. He has a 2.25 ERA in 5 outings since returning from thoracic outlet surgery — one of the best comeback stories of 2026.

sources.title: Can Zack Wheeler Sustain His Strong Start to 2026?

players.name: Cole Ragans
players.summary: Ragans remains on the 15-day IL (retroactive to May 7) with left elbow impingement. He has been playing catch with increasing intensity as of May 13 but no return date has been announced.

sources.title: Cole Ragans Making Headway in Rehab

players.name: Chase Burns
players.summary: Burns is between starts after reaching 100 strikeouts faster than any pitcher in Reds history. He last started Tuesday (win, 6 IP, 9 K vs. Rockies) and is one of the best young starters in baseball.

sources.title: Chase Burns reaches 100 Ks faster than any Reds pitcher

players.name: Nathan Eovaldi
players.summary: Eovaldi was scratched May 12 with left side tightness but threw a bullpen May 14 and said he feels good. He is expected to make his scheduled start Sunday May 17.

sources.title: Rangers' Nathan Eovaldi scratched due to left side tightness — ESPN

players.name: Emmet Sheehan
players.summary: Sheehan is between starts after his best outing of 2026 (6 IP, 2 ER, 6 K vs. Giants on May 14, per Dave Roberts). Wrobleski started for LAD on Saturday vs. the Angels.

sources.title: Emmet Sheehan shows growth as pitcher and leader in Dodgers win

players.name: Reid Detmers
players.summary: Detmers was not scheduled to start Saturday; Jose Soriano started for LAA vs. the Dodgers (LAA lost 15-2). Detmers has a 5.80 ERA across 10 starts this season in his return to the rotation.

injuries.name: Cal Raleigh
injuries.note: First career IL stint; earliest return May 24; Mariners optimistic it will not be long-term.

source.title: Cal Raleigh on his oblique injury and rehab timeline

injuries.name: Cole Ragans
injuries.note: Placed on IL retroactive to May 7 after exiting May 6 start vs. Guardians with triceps and elbow soreness.

source.title: Cole Ragans Injury: Exits with sore triceps

injuries.name: Nathan Eovaldi
injuries.note: Scratched May 12 start vs. Arizona; bullpen session May 14 went well; expects to start Sunday May 17.

source.title: Rangers' Nathan Eovaldi scratched due to left side tightness

injuries.name: Teoscar Hernandez
injuries.note: Activated from IL for Saturday's game; contributed 2 RBI in Dodgers' 15-2 win over Angels.

source.title: Teoscar Hernandez Responded Well To Dodgers Lineup Change
